preview: Preview leaves owner and invitation acceptance unchanged, before and after acceptance.
authorization: Only the named recipient can accept. Other actors are rejected without state changes, even after settlement.
acceptance: The first acceptance by the recipient succeeds, transfers ownership to the recipient and marks the invitation accepted.
repeat: Repeated recipient acceptance may succeed or reject, but must preserve settled ownership and invitation status.
observations: owner: 0 sender, 1 recipient, 2 other, 3 unrecognized owner; accepted: 0 false, 1 true. Read from actual fixture state.
scope: One sequential in-memory ticket transfer; synthetic accounts; no HTTP, signed links, provider, persistence or concurrency.
authority: Local reviewable milestone-3 expectations extending the fixture's existing preview and recipient authorization obligations. Duplicate return semantics deliberately left open.
